source.title: Independently archived Enchantrix personal SavedVariables checked for original processing counters

notes: Thirteen newly inspected archived original/backup account files (from several independent GitHub repositories) contain empty EnchantedLocal, ProspectedLocal and MillingLocal; some have populated generic item information, which is not a measured processing event. No new measured denominator, hit counts, zeros, quantities or item-specific 24995 event found. This is source-exhaustion only, not processing evidence. Item-name searches additionally covered Wowhead, Warcraft Wiki, WoWDB, Evowow and WoW-Professions; duplicate historical commenter cohorts were not copied.
lookingFor: Previously uninspected original Enchantrix account processing counters for Cobalt Ore 36909, Fel Iron Ore 23424 and TBC disenchant gear including Warmaul Legplates 24995
whereLooked: Item-name searches: Warmaul Legplates (Wowhead Classic/WotLK, Warcraft Wiki, WoWDB, Evowow) — historical/modern conflict already recorded, no new individual cast log
Item-name searches: Cobalt Ore (Wowhead regional comments, Warcraft Wiki and WoW-Professions) — existing 180-ore, 24-stack and reference results; no per-output zeros
Item-name searches: Fel Iron Ore (Wowhead TBC/WotLK, Warcraft Wiki and WoW-Professions) — previously recorded 100-/565-ore cohorts, no new completed-cast export
